review_comments.body: **Empty cookies gain a separator.** An enabled `Cookie` header can have an empty value, including after a template renders. With jar cookies present, this helper now sends `; session=abc` instead of the previous `session=abc`. The leading empty cookie is outside the expected cookie format and can cause strict servers to reject an otherwise valid upgrade. Treat an empty or whitespace-only existing value as absent, and add a test for it.
